scope: Static comparison of the fictional upload plan against its terminal-outcome contract.

assumptions: The supplied contract defines all upload outcomes.

lenses.reason: Compare the state mapping against the contract.
Compare terminal feedback and the offered next action.

evidence.observation: Cancellation is terminal and requires Canceled with Upload again.
Every outcome except success and error maps to Uploading with Cancel.

checks.criterion: Canceled must map to Canceled with Upload again.
checks.limitation: Author-written illustrative comparison; no running UI was tested.

candidates.reason: Cancellation falls through to the running state.
Offering Cancel again is a consequence of the same missing state mapping.

findings.title: Canceled uploads remain labeled Uploading
findings.trigger: An upload reaches the canceled outcome.
findings.consequence: The proposed mapping shows ongoing work and offers Cancel again, contrary to the terminal-state contract.
findings.uncertainty: Only the proposed mapping is inspected; implemented behavior is unknown.
findings.recommendation: Add a canceled row with an Upload again action.

limits: Fictional, author-written example, not a captured model review.
No implementation, keyboard operation, timing, or user comprehension was tested.
